summary: Rank-local CSR pointers are rebased. An untimed warmup precedes the timed runtime-count loop; each iteration calls the chosen launchSpMV selector, synchronization precedes copying the local output and gather. The final kernel's row guard, CSR interval and output store cover all rank-local rows/nonzeros. The runtime-count timed main loop calls the selector `launchSpMV`; its full host body chooses the thread- or warp-per-row device variant and tail-jumps to the corresponding actual device stub. Both selected stubs reach cudaLaunchKernel. The two final SASS variants cover their complete row/nonzero work and stores, as documented in correction-v2.
